content.comment_body: Issue resolved—the missing command was Cli_Connect(), which establishes an implicit connection to the PLC. Now I'm wondering: can data be read cyclically, similar to HMI function, when using snap7?

analysis.insight_summary: The user asks if snap7 supports cyclic data reading from a [company_name] PLC, like the behavior seen with HMI devices. Their initial connection problem was resolved after adding the correct command. The user seeks to achieve continuous PLC data polling using a third-party library.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to perform regular, cyclical data reading from the PLC with snap7, mirroring how HMI systems operate.
